items.description: A rugged granite island known for its untouched rainforest and status as a protected nature reserve.
A majestic peak on Mahé offering panoramic views of the island's lush landscape and surrounding ocean.
An pristine beach on Praslin, celebrated for its turquoise waters, white sand, and secluded setting.
A dramatic beach on Mahé known for its powerful waves and stunning granite rock formations.
A small, tranquil islet off the coast of Mahé, offering a secluded natural sanctuary and diverse marine life.
A scenic island known for its rich biodiversity and spectacular natural scenery among the inner islands.
